From: Evan Park <evan.park@clearshore.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: restore replay transcript + telemetry for RPO audit

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As part of our SIG/CAIQ follow-up the internal audit team has asked for a reproducible playback of the outage simulation Redwood ran on Oct 2. Could you provide the following artifacts?

- Step-by-step restore transcript (server timestamps + command trace)
- KV-cache warmup metrics with per-shard timings and first-successful-read timestamps
- Any replay/restore telemetry (latency distribution, token/segment counts) for the us-west-2 region
- A signed manifest or checksum bundle we can use to assert provenance for the attachments

Ideally we would also like a short video or screen capture of the restore playback (even a time-compressed recording) and a short note describing how the RTO/RPO numbers were measured during the run. Our audit window is next week, so if you can get this over by EOD Thursday that would be great.

If any of these items require a live witness or NDA amendment, let me know — we can accommodate.

Appreciate the help,
Evan
Evan Park
Sr. Information Risk Manager | Clearshore Financial

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan and what to expect: 

1) Attachments: we will produce a compressed log bundle containing the full restore transcript, a CSV of per-shard KV warmup timings, and a SHA256-signed manifest. Expect 3 files.
2) Telemetry summary: a short one-page summary describing the RTO/RPO measurement method (what timestamps we used, how KV primers are counted) and aggregate latency percentiles.
3) Playback video: we can provide a time-lapse capture of the restore orchestration UI plus a short narrated notes file. If Clearshore needs a live witness playback, we can schedule a 30-minute session next week.

Ben (cc'd) will drop the log bundle here shortly. Karthik will include the RPO timing methodology and the checksum.

We will upload the artifacts to a Read-only Drive folder and send the link plus manifest. If you need documents notarized/signed, flag that now and I will route to Legal for the attestation.

Target delivery: Thu 8 Oct 2026 EOD PT.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Evan — quick addendum on the RPO definition we used (pasted here for the auditors):

- RPO anchor: first_served_read_utc (the first successful read of a restored segment as observed by application-level health checks).
- RTO measurement: wall-clock time from orchestration trigger (orch-trigger-utc) to the final readiness indicator reported by the load-balancer (lb-ready-utc).
- Warmup: KV warmup is counted per-process and aggregated across shards; the CSV includes the 50th/95th percentile for warmup completion.

If you want a short walkthrough, Naomi and I can do a 30-minute live replay next Tue (Oct 13) at 10am PT. Otherwise, please review the artifacts and confirm if the manifest + signatures are sufficient for your SIG.

—Karthik
Applied ML / Inference Reliability
Redwood Inference
